$comment: Third-party code and binaries that reach PiArc's release artefacts without a package manager, so Cargo and npm metadata cannot list them (architecture section 10.4).
T50's scripts/release/gen-notices.mjs reads this file, together with the Cargo and npm dependency trees, to generate THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. Every entry names its license text in this repository.
Add an entry in the same change that vendors code or links a prebuilt binary.

components.name: libghostty-vt
components.usedBy: crates/piarc-ghostty-sys: linked statically into the macOS Core module; ghostty-vt.dll ships next to the Windows Core module
components.notes: The library bundles simdutf, Highway and Wuffs (permissive licenses, no copyleft; docs/research/terminal-libghostty.md section 1.1). T50 checks their license texts against the release's source tarball when generating the notices.

components.name: ghostty-web CanvasRenderer (fork)
components.usedBy: apps/desktop/src/renderer/terminal/vendor/ghostty-web/renderer.ts (modified; changes listed in README.md next to it)

components.name: OpenAI Codex Seatbelt base policy
components.usedBy: crates/piarc-sandbox/src/seatbelt/base.sbpl (copied unmodified after a PiArc header comment; compiled into the Core module with include_str!)
components.notes: Codex's NOTICE reads "OpenAI Codex / Copyright 2025 OpenAI" (its Ratatui note concerns code PiArc does not use); T50 reproduces it in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
